summary.systemic_concern: Template-based difficulty assignment from DL-012 clone-group rotation. 5-item groups assign difficulty by position (Easy, Moderate, Moderate, Difficult, Moderate) without cognitive assessment.

flagged_items.reason: Tests name-recognition of three-lines model. Stem presents definition; candidate matches to correct term. No analysis or evaluation required. Bloom's Remember/Understand level. Stored label 'Difficult' is inflated — DS=2 (Moderate-Easy) is closer but still one step above actual cognitive demand.

Topic is straightforward independent verification concept — 'one supervisor recounting inventory.' Agent D notes: 'Topic labeled Difficult but is straightforward independent verification concept.' DS=2 is closer than 'Difficult' label but still above actual cognitive demand.

Tests basic authorization control classification — 'Manager approval before placing high-dollar purchase orders.' Agent D: 'Labeled Difficult but topic is basic authorization control classification.' Definition-recognition at Understand level.

Tests name-recognition of COSO framework — 'which framework... Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities, Information & Communication, Monitoring.' Pure recall. Agent D: 'Tests name-recognition of COSO framework - low topic sensitivity.' DS=2 is one step above actual cognitive demand.

flagged_items.topic: Segregation incompatible duties cash custody and recording
flagged_items.reason: CORRECTLY CALIBRATED. Included as a reference example — this item has DS=1 (Easy) for a definition-level SoD recognition item. Agent D: 'Very low cognitive demand - definition-level recognition.' Demonstrates correct calibration to contrast with inflated items.

Approximately 30 of 38 seeds have DS=3 (Moderate) testing primarily Remember or Understand level COSO concepts. The template-rotation pipeline assigned difficulty by position, not by cognitive assessment. Items testing 'what is the fraud triangle,' 'what is a whistleblower hotline,' 'what is a compensating control' should be Easy (1), not Moderate (3). Items with applied scenarios (vendor-specific SoD, ERM risk appetite with scenario) may correctly be Moderate (3).

caqs_target_comparison.note: Seeds only (38 items) are too small a sample for CAQS §6.1 distribution compliance. The difficulty label corrections primarily serve content-quality accuracy, not distribution targets.

cognitive_level_alignment.note: Zero items at Analyze or Evaluate level across all 38 seeds. Domain E (Internal Controls) at the seed level tests predominantly definition-recognition (Remember/Understand). Applied scenarios (vendor SoD, fraud purchasing, ERM risk appetite) reach Apply level.
